new_en: You wake up to a pressure on your face. Putting your hands to your face, you feel a gas mask. You try to remove it, but it seems like it's fused with your skin.
Looking around, you can barely see anything. The only light emanating from the mining helmet on your head reveals that you're in a cave tunnel held by wooden supports.
Something's wrong. You know this place. This can't be real. You have to wake up.
You rush to your feet in panic.
You raise yourself off the hard rock.
A heavy rumbling from all around you threatens to send you back down, but you manage to grab onto the tunnel wall.
The rumbling quickly subsides and you get your footing on the hard ground.
You can't stay here. You have to get out. You start running as fast as you can down the tunnel, but another rumble knocks you off your feet.<>
With no other options, you start to walk down the tunnel. You keep walking and walking and walking. You start to wonder if there is an end as another rumble knocks you off your feet. <>
Rocks start falling all around you. You hear the supports start to splinter and crack. You try to get up and run to safety, but a boulder lands on your back and pins you to the ground. <<gggpain>>
You try to struggle out from under the boulder, but you can't move! You keep trying as rocks keep falling around you. Another boulder falls onto your leg, pinning it to the rock. <>
You hear a large snap as a support crumbles in front of you, followed by a wave of rocks covering you.
You close your eyes as hard as you can. The sound of rocks falling and wood cracking fills your ears. <<ggstress>><<ggpain>>

You find it getting hard to breathe as more rocks crumble on top of you, any attempt to move only increases the weight bearing down on you. The sounds begin to cease and everything goes silent. You open your eyes to reveal a small pocket in front of you, illuminated by your headlamp. You again try your hardest to move, but you're completely stuck.
You yell for help, but no response comes, you yell and yell until your voice gives out. You're alone. Eventually the headlamp on your helmet starts to dim and darkness envelops you.
You're stuck, there's no way out. It's so hard to breathe. Feeling starts to vanish from your limbs. Your consciousness starts to slip as you stop breathing.
You have to wake up, you have to get out. You can't stay here. You close your eyes.
<<link [[Wake up, you have to wake up.|Nightmare Mine End]]>><</link>>
This can't be a dream, this isn't a dream, this is real.
You slowly open your eyes, revealing the world around you. <<lstress>><<stress -2>>
You open your eyes with a gasp, air filling your lungs. <<ggstress>><<stress 15>>
You sigh in relief, it was only a dream.
